title: QA Config
description: Configuration for automatic QA sub-issue extraction from unverifiable acceptance criteria

keywords.description: Case-insensitive keywords that PROPOSE manual QA for an AC (#3362): a match never files on its own — the automationRoutes answers decide

automationRoutes.description: The automation routes a session must answer, each with a specific reason it cannot reach the check, before a check is handed to a person (#3362) — by /qa before Outcome 3 and by qa-extract.js before filing

genericReasons.description: Reasons that explain nothing about why a route fails (#3362). Compared case-insensitively after trimming and dropping trailing punctuation; a route answered with one is treated as unanswered

fixturesTemplate.description: Appended to the rendered body only when the --fill entry supplies `fixtures` (#2827). Must carry the `### Fixtures` heading qa-fixtures.js reads and the {fixtures} placeholder.
